name: Nile
source:
Originally from Egypt, she was brought over as part of an exhibition on mummies when her slumber was disturbed and she subsequently escaped. She spent quite a long time wandering aimlessly on the west coast until she found her true calling. She actually only recently moved to Langsdon, at the request of the mayor, as the world's premier Undead Psychologist. She has a big heart, and incredibly clear skin (what's her secret!?).

[From [url=https://swb-media.itch.io/creature-consorts]Itch.io[/url]]
